name: Qualified ideal zinc-blende CdSe bulk reference
phaseScope: Independent constructed ideal zinc-blende CdSe bulk cell, using cached a=6.077 Å from epitaxial-film literature. It illustrates only the source literature-attributed stearate phase or the source SAXS shape model. No measured nanocrystal lattice, finite particle, surface or exact sample coordinates are assigned. CIF P1 is the explicit eight-site export of the ideal F-43m basis, not a measured P1 phase.

lattice_parameter.citation: N. Samarth et al., Growth of cubic (zinc blende) CdSe by molecular beam epitaxy, Applied Physics Letters 54 (1989), 2680–2682
lattice_parameter.note: 6.077 Å is the cached epitaxial-film lattice reference; not measured for any specimen in this paper.

source.adaptation: Only schema conversion and Cartesian multiplication of the existing fractional sites; no fitted or newly retrieved coordinates.

renderingNotes: Fractional coordinates multiply by a=6.077 to obtain Cartesian angstrom coordinates.
Nearest Cd-Se distance is sqrt(3)*a/4, approximately 2.6314 angstrom.
Do not label surface ligands, defects, strain, reconstructions or electronic wavefunctions as measured by this geometry.
